description: Machine-readable conformance fixture definitions for Writer Storage Policy capabilities (P01–P12). Each capability defines the input, expected semantics, and wire constraints.

capabilities.name: policy_enumeration
capabilities.description: StoragePolicy type exposes exactly four values: HIGHLY_VERTICAL(1), VERTICAL(2), HORIZONTAL(3), HIGHLY_HORIZONTAL(4). No additional values permitted.
capabilities.test_pattern: verify enum has exactly 4 members; all map to int 1-4

capabilities.name: storage_policy_wire_encoding
capabilities.description: Storage Policy value is directly encoded in .vsn via REC_STORAGE_POLICY (0x0009) / FID_STORAGE_POLICY (0x0901). No MODERN/ENTERPRISE mapping.
capabilities.test_pattern: parse(.vsn) -> find REC_STORAGE_POLICY record (0x0009) with FID_STORAGE_POLICY (0x0901) == expected policy value

capabilities.name: storage_policy_in_container
capabilities.description: Actual VSN containers produced under each policy carry the correct REC_STORAGE_POLICY record (record type 0x0009 with field FID_STORAGE_POLICY=0x0901). No ModeDeclaration used.
capabilities.test_pattern: parse(.vsn) -> find REC_STORAGE_POLICY record (0x0009); verify no ModeDeclaration record; value matches expected policy

capabilities.name: reader_independence
capabilities.description: A reader implementing the VSN parser can decode any container produced by any storage policy without that policy name appearing in the binary. The reader needs only ModeDeclaration to determine representation family.
capabilities.test_pattern: parse each policy fixture; verify mode declaration present and valid; verify no policy name string in raw bytes

capabilities.name: logical_equivalence
capabilities.description: Writing identical content under different policies produces containers with equivalent logical semantics: same FileId, same content, same object serials (per ObjectSerial rules), but potentially different wire layout.
capabilities.input_description: identical payload written under all four policies

wire_constraints.note: raw bytes may differ (different representation choices); do NOT compare raw bytes across policies

capabilities.test_pattern: create identical files under HV/VERT/HOR/HHOR; compare parsed logical semantics; assert NOT raw byte equality

capabilities.name: object_serial_preservation
capabilities.description: ObjectSerial identity is preserved across policy changes. Objects that are not rewritten retain their ObjectSerial per ID-03, ID-09, SR-37.
capabilities.input_description: single file written under HIGHLY_VERTICAL, then container reopened and read under HORIZONTAL (no write)

wire_constraints.note: ObjectSerial comparison follows frozen protocol rules (ID-03/ID-09), not policy-specific rules

capabilities.test_pattern: write HV -> commit; reopen under HOR; verify same object serials and content
